thread:
Jordan (AE): Quick sync — customer wants a BYO‑HSM POC + dedicated throughput numbers before committing. Need SOW clar and pricing delta. Who can help with rotation SLA and audit log coverage? cc @Priya
Priya (SalesEng): I can take rotation/SLA. Clarify: are they asking for CMKs in our KMS proxy or a pure HSM bridge where keys never touch our control plane? That changes acceptance tests.
Sam (SRE): They described an on‑prem HSM with replication to our Dedicated region for failover. Key rotation window must be <=15m failure‑safe during cutover. Also asked about TPM/attestation flow — do we require vendor attestation? :thinking_face:
Elena (Security): We need hardware attestation (HW‑backed cert) + provenance proof for key origin. Rotation events must emit audit entries we can forward to customer's SIEM. Is the plan push (syslog) or pull via agent?
Priya (SalesEng): We support push via syslog and can deliver signed audit bundles to an S3 bucket. For rotation there are two supported modes: (1) customer rotates keys in their HSM and we validate via audit + handshake, or (2) customer gives ephemeral delegation to our KMS proxy for rotation. Each has different risk profile and pricing.
Jordan (AE): Procurement also asked for a delta compared to standard hosted API and Dedicated w/out BYOK. They want a monthly commit estimate for ~100 TPS inference sessions (small token sizes) and 99.95% availability target. Any rough numbers?
Sam (SRE): Back‑of‑envelope: 100 TPS steady ≈ 1–2 reserved GPU pods depending on model. HSM ops become the limiter — expect additional throughput constraints for crypto ops. Operationally add a dedicated runbook, monthly on‑call hours and rotation rehearsals — call it a one‑time SOW (2–3 weeks) + $Xk/mo for HSM ops/audit retention. I’ll pencil concrete numbers after the sim.
Priya (SalesEng): I'll draft SOW bullets: network connectivity (IP allowlist, firewall rules), cert rotation cadence, key ceremony schedule, test vectors + harness, acceptance criteria (successful encrypt/decrypt, rotation dry run without data loss, throughput check), and KMS API compatibility matrix.
Jordan (AE): On acceptance — customer insists on an automated dry‑run rotation that proves zero downtime. Can we present a sample runbook + test harness early?
Sam (SRE): We have a small harness we can run with customer's endpoints. Example of the command we run during POC:
```
./rotation-dryrun --env=staging --key-id=proj-abc --simulate --verify-audit
```
We can execute it against their HSM endpoints behind their VPC peering or VPN.
Elena (Security): Also flag legal/security requirements: key custody clause, incident notification window (<=2 hrs), and mandatory replayable audit logs for rotation events. I’ll add these to our security questionnaire answers.
Priya (SalesEng): Procurement will want line‑itemized pricing: (A) BYOK connector one‑time integration, (B) monthly dedicated capacity, (C) HSM ops & audit retention, (D) optional rotation automation. I’ll prepare three pricing bands (baseline / rotation automated / fully‑managed).
Jordan (AE): I’ll get the testbed owners to share IPs and contact — sending devops@cust.com now. Also asked for explicit SLA escalation path (names + emails).
deploy-bot: SOW draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sow/POC-1715556666 — please review and comment.
Priya (SalesEng): Got the link. Will review and propose pricing bands + acceptance test cases by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (SRE): I’ll run a quick throughput + HSM latency sim Wednesday morning against a synthetic workload. Ping me if you want to join the run.
Jordan (AE): Thanks — let’s converge on SOW + pricing tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
